checks.message: Verify --duration-seconds is set to the minimum required
checks.context: The default max session duration for assumed roles is 1 hour, but roles can be configured to allow up to 12 hours (43200s). Attackers who compromise credentials frequently use sts assume-role with maximum duration to maintain persistence even after the original credentials are rotated. Always use the shortest duration your workload needs.

checks.message: MFA device not set — session token will have no MFA context
checks.context: Session tokens generated without --serial-number and --token-code have no MFA context. Any IAM policy conditions using aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent will deny requests made with this token. More importantly, without MFA the token provides no stronger security guarantee than the long-lived credentials it was generated from.
